description: This file defines the LatestVersionSelector class which implements the IVersionSelector interface. It provides logic to select the most suitable version from a list of available versions based on compatibility and maximum version criteria.

classes.name: LatestVersionSelector
classes.description: A class that selects the latest compatible version from a list of available versions.

methods.name: GetSuitableVersion
methods.description: Returns the highest compatible version from the available versions based on the requested version and compatibility checks.
